summary: An execution profile was created at its first revision, naming the agent host the work it runs is launched on.

new.description: What the first revision says about the launch: the host, the program and the host version it was verified against. The arguments, the denials and the tools are kept on the revision, not on the line.

program.description: The program the host is started as.

host_version_verified.description: The host version the person verified the profile against, or null where none was stated.
